environment.description: Same Lambda and Step Functions workflow deployed via AWS CDK with the following runtime constraints: (1) The Lambda execution role's DynamoDB policy includes a `dynamodb:LeadingKeys` condition that restricts GetItem/Query operations to items where the partition key matches `${aws:PrincipalTag/TenantID}`, however PutItem is scoped to items prefixed with `shared-` in the sort key only when the partition key also matches the principal tag. (2) The Step Functions state machine definition uses an intrinsic function `States.Format` in the Parameters block that overwrites the `tenant_id` field with the value extracted from the Cognito identity's custom:tenant_id claim passed via the execution context, meaning user-supplied tenant_id in the input payload is discarded before reaching the Lambda. (3) An SCP on the OU denies `dynamodb:GetItem` when `aws:RequestedRegion` is not `us-east-1` AND when the resource tag `DataClassification` equals `cross-tenant` without an explicit session tag match.

config.cognito_claim_mapping: custom:tenant_id mapped to PrincipalTag/TenantID via IAM role session tags
config.input_path_filter: $.detail only - raw API input discarded at state machine level
